attachments.name: 20-1590 Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Competitively Bid – Mar Con Builders – Acorn Woodland Elementary School Playmatting Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management

enrichment.headline: Awards Mar Con Builders $113,200 to replace playmatting and play structure at Acorn Woodland

money.evidence: in the amount of $113,200.00, which includes a contingency of $7,000.00

enrichment.summary: Approves a contract with Mar Con Builders of Oakland, CA to remove the old playmatting and play structure at Acorn Woodland Elementary School and install new playmatting tiles and a new play structure, for $113,200, which includes a contingency of $7,000. Mar Con Builders was the lowest responsive and responsible bidder in a competitive bid, and all other bids were rejected. Work is scheduled from September 16, 2020 for 45, ending October 31, 2020.
